steps.name: Laura
steps.text: I must be seeing things.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: According to the results of the investigation, almost no part of the tower is intact. Everything's either damaged or ruined, and a lot of parts are flat out missing. It should've collapsed ages ago.

steps.name: Blacksteel Technician
steps.text: Same over here. Almost all the spare parts are gone. Even the conveyor belt has been dismantled.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: *sigh*... A caravan stops by Davistown about once every two months. We have to trade for our necessities, usually with defunct industrial equipment.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hmph, you call that a trade? More like robbing us blind! See that forklift? Hardly ever used and practically new! Well, at least eighty percent new!

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: And do you know how much the traders offered for it? Ten boxes of canned food!

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Well, we gotta eat.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: ...By the looks of it, the plant was already in extreme disrepair even before the accident.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: We used to have a whole lotta workers on the job, but now Miles is the only one left. It'd be great if he could keep things running on his own, but we'd need about ten more of him.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Tell me about it. Wish I could split myself into a hundred copies and put 'em to use right about now... This job's not as simple as the checklist makes it seem. If we don't play our cards right, we could be stuck here for a whole year.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: C'mon, don't say that... I was counting on that 200 grand after a week.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: 200 grand is nothing. Land yourself a security job with a venture capitalist in Trimounts, I guarantee you'll earn a whole lot more than that.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: When my employer was satisfied with my services, he waved his hand, gave me 200 mil, and whispered in my ear: 'Consider this an investment in you. You've earned it.'

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Seriously? 200 mil?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: With that much money, we could renovate all of Davistown.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Heh, just messing with you. I once blew that much money on a little project at Blacksteel, though... Totally not worth it, by the way.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Stop dreaming, girl, and get back to work.

steps.name: Blacksteel Technician
steps.text: Just so you know, old timer, count yourself lucky when you can hear Laura go off on her random tangents. Her mind's always racing while she's working, so she talks nonsense as a way to release the pressure. If she suddenly stops, it means...

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: It means what?

steps.name: Blacksteel Technician
steps.text: ...It means the problem's too big, and her brain's short circuiting.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: (*gulp*)

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: ...Okay everyone, listen closely. Stop whatever you're doing, and leave the energy tower back the way you came, hurry!

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: I mean now!

steps.name: Bored Bank Employee
steps.text: Sylvia, can you finish processing the bank statements before nine tonight?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: N-No problem.

steps.name: Bored Bank Employee
steps.text: Then I'll leave you to it.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Bored Bank Employee
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Bored Bank Employee
steps.text: Ugh, how long has the manager been talking with those two?

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: ...the situation... the account does not look very optimistic...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...that is not... wise course of action...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Wait, Liskarm, I think I heard something!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: A blackout... The energy tower?!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Sorry, something urgent came up. We'll need to confirm the situation first and explain things later.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: I don't mind, go right ahead.

steps.name: Indifferent Bank Employee
steps.text: Aw, looks like the backup power is working. I was hoping we could clock out early because of the blackout.

steps.name: Bored Bank Employee
steps.text: What's the rush? Not like there's anything to do after work.

steps.name: Bored Bank Employee
steps.text: I've just about had it with this damn place. No bars, no nightclubs, just a tiny diner serving barely-edible slop. And now even the half-dead energy tower isn't working anymore.

steps.name: Bored Bank Employee
steps.text: Hey Sylvia, why didn't your mother open up more restaurants when she was mayor? Did she lose her sense of taste or what?

steps.name: Bored Bank Employee
steps.text: Sylvia?

steps.name: Indifferent Bank Employee
steps.text: Huh, did she slink away while the power was out?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The plate... what's going on?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Laura?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Hello, Laura? Do you copy?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Laura?!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Woodrow!

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Did something happen back in town?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I... I don't know, but things don't look too good so I'm heading back!

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Gimme a ride.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Okay!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Where are you, Jessica?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Captain Liskarm? I haven't been able to get in touch with Laura! What's going on over there?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We were briefly able to make contact with her, but the signal is awful. All we know is that an emergency occurred during the repairs, but she isn't in any immediate danger for now.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Don't panic. Just worry about yourself, and we'll meet up at Helena's diner. Understood?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Got it!

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Can you make this thing go any faster?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sorry...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Stop crying, I'm asking you to speed up, not trying to bully you. Your captain just told you that Laura's not in any danger.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Not for now. There's obviously a major problem with the energy tower, so if she doesn't evacuate in time...

spans.text: . There's obviously a major problem with the energy tower, so if she doesn't evacuate in time...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Hypothetically, if she really did have an accident, how would you rushing over help at all?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I don't know... but I have to. We're partners, so if I'm not there for her, who else would be?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: (*mumbles*) Partners, huh...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: The roads around Davistown ain't in great shape, so you'd best drive carefully. Watch the turn up ahead.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Thanks for letting us wait here, ma'am.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Don't worry about it. The power's out anyhow, and it don't matter who helps with the emergency generator. You're here, and the diner's that much warmer for it. Just gimme a holler if you need anything.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Is that... one of our squad members outside the window?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Where's Laura? And the others?

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*... Still inside the tower.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What exactly happened in there?

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Laura suddenly told everyone to stop repairs and evacuate the tower ASAP.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Once we were out, she asked all the Infected members to stay behind and had everyone else, including Miles and Leone, get as far away as possible.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Then... she took those people back in, and said that if she's not out by eight, all the residents on the plate need to be evacuated immediately.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Could you confirm the exact situation?

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: She... didn't say.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Can you try contacting Laura again?

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: That... won't work.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What about the others? We've still got half the team in there!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Enough of this. I'm heading over there myself.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Sit down, Franka.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Captain, you should know this better than me. Even if there was an explosion in there, it wouldn't take out everyone's communicators all at once.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: The fact that we can't reach any of them probably means that a shit-ton of active Originium got released, which is jamming the comms.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: No matter how you slice it, this is an emergency, Liskarm.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: And what would rushing over there accomplish? Don't forget what she said: if we don't hear back from her by eight, we need to prepare to evacuate the entire plate.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If we went with your plan and something really did happen, who's going to evacuate the residents? The government officials in the bank's garage?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What, then we're going to let Laura and her team fend for themselves? While we just sit around?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Don't let your concern for them cloud your judgment, Franka.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I hate to bother you, but what time is it now?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Laura—

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh... It's you, Sylvia.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Wh-What happened? You all look so... tense...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: An accident occurred while repairing the power plant, but we still don't know the details. We're waiting for follow-up report.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: No wonder the power went out... If, um, if there's anything I can do to help...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Sir, where are you going?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Heading out for a walk. This place is too damn stuffy.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I respect your courage, Sylvia, but what we need right now is patience.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: ...Umm, my mother... she was the second to last mayor here. She worked here all her life.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: But, she got sick... and I had to get a job, so I joined the bank... I never meant to betray anyone.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: I don't know what Mr. Theremin told you, but you have to believe me when I say I want to help...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You seem to be misunderstanding something. Leone hasn't said a thing about you.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: R-Really? Sorry for jumping to conclusions...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If you're worried about the energy tower, then you can sit here with us and wait for the news.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: No... I still think...

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Fine... I'll wait here with you.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If no one else has any objections, this is the plan we'll follow to carry out the evacuation, if it comes to it.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Thank you for the hard work, everyone. Franka and I will stand guard, so the rest of you can take a breather for the time being.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: *sigh*... What time is it now, Captain Liskarm?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Seven, on the dot.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...Only one hour left.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Are we... really going to just sit here until eight?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Th-This is Jessica, reporting in! I've returned to the squad!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: How's Laura doing? When are we heading out?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: If you're asking when we're leaving, that'd be eight o'clock. If you're asking when we're sending backup...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I'm not in the mood to argue with a certain Vouivre right now. Ask her yourself.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: An evacuation?!

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: There's less than an hour left. You sure you wanna play the waiting game?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Excuse me, but who might you be?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: This is Woodrow, a local, umm... hunter.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You two know each other?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: I'm the one who took her back to town when she got lost outside. We bumped into each other just now, so she gave me a lift.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...Well, thank you for helping her out, sir.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: If something went wrong in the energy tower, why are y'all just sitting around out here?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We trust in our colleagues' ability to resolve the crisis. They're all professionals at handling Originium pollution.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Really now? Your deputy sure ain't as calm about the situation.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Sir, if an accident really breaks out, then we need to be on standby to evacuate the residents immediately. And we can only do that by staying here.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Awful generous of you to share all that with an outsider.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: But I ain't one of your colleagues. If you're not going, I'll check it out myself.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: That would be extremely dangerous—

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Thanks for the tip.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Wait, Woodrow!

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...I'll go with you.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Jessica?!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Don't be rash. Have some faith in Laura. Even if you went—

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I know. But even if there's not a whole lot I can do... She's still inside that tower.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: If she makes it out safely, the least I can do is be there for her with a hug.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: And if something were to happen... I'd have a chance to rush in there.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Alright then, let's get going, young lady.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: L-Laura?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Move over, Jessica...

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: I'm starving to death here. Don't go blocking the door to the diner...

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: R-Reporting in, Captain Liskarm. I, and the rest of the squad, have safely returned...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Thank heaven you're alright...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Laura...

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Phew... In any case, uhh, the explosion caused a large amount of Originium sediment to build up inside the plant's pipes, which is a critical situation that could've boiled over at a moments notice.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Out of safety concerns, I ordered everyone outside first and tried to come up with a plan. But no matter what course of action we chose, there was a not insignificant chance of activating the sediment.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Laura—

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Captain, please stop asking. No matter how much you ask, there's not much else I could do to fix things up on such short notice. But I did manage to find a way to preserve the plant's basic heating functionality. So at least people won't be freezing to death...

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: As for whether the plate can start moving again, that'll have to wait until—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Laura! That's enough!

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Captain...

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: This really was... the best I could do... I'm so sorry...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: No, what I was trying to say is that what matters is that you brought everyone back safely.

spans.text: to say is that what matters is that you brought everyone back safely.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Oh, really? That's good then... Actually... I'm really hungry right now... Like, really, really hungry...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Then let's go ahead and eat first.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Eat as much as you want, and get a good night's rest.
